name: R-One
group: Robocath (acquired by Stereotaxis, closed 2026-07-07); Cathbot JV with MicroPort MedBot
versions: R-One (CE 2019); R-One+; second-generation robot (up to 5 devices, first-in-human started 2026-01-27, 20 pts planned); R-ONE (NMPA 2023-12-08 via Cathbot JV)
devices_driven: 0.014-in guidewire + rapid-exchange balloon/stent catheter; guide catheter manual. Next-gen: up to 5 devices simultaneously (press)
translation_detail: other: motorised pads combining translation and rotation
imaging_compat: standard fluoroscopy; robot placed on table beside patient (official photo)
sterility: single-use cassette (clear cover visible in company photo)
validation_detail: R-EVOLUTION 62 pts, 6 sites; registrational trial 145 pts (MicroPort, press); FIH of 2nd-gen 2026 (press)
key_numbers: R-EVOLUTION: technical success 59/62 (95.2%), clinical success 100%, 3 conversions (1 robot-related); robotic 19.9+-9.6 of 39.9+-14.6 min; operator dose -84.5% under apron (durand2023_evaluation Results, partial). 15 systems installed worldwide (medtechdive, web).
